title: Kamrupar Buranji
author: Dr. Suryya Kumar Bhuyan
description: Historical account compiled from ancient chronicles describing medieval western Assam, the frontier clashes between the Tai Ahom realm and Mughal imperial armies, and the diplomatic treaties that secured the independence of the Tai state.

sentences.free_translation_en: The Tai king established the frontier boundary of the country.
